scope: Operational reliability and read-only freshness-policy evidence only; no model, threshold, execution, live-gate, wallet, signing, funding, or real-money change.

pull_request.title: Fix Polymarket rotating subscriptions after reconnect
pull_request.scope_note: The repair persists the net current Polymarket market asset subscription set after dynamic subscribe/unsubscribe messages so reconnects reuse the rotated set. The frozen 10-second selected-book freshness rule was not changed.

reconnect_repair_acceptance.interpretation: The reconnect-resubscription defect is operationally confirmed repaired. Later selected_book_missing observations described below are attributable to the frozen event-age freshness contract, not silent loss of rotated websocket subscriptions.

post_merge_production_deployment.note: A prior failed gh invocation occurred inside an old shell with an ERR rollback trap and safely restored the host to the previous deployment before this final merged deployment. No real-money configuration changed.

freshness_policy_evidence.evidence_start_basis: bp-recorder.service ActiveEnterTimestamp after final merged deployment

descriptive_freshness_only_sensitivity.note: Descriptive only. These counts do not establish that a row would trade because downstream edge/policy checks still apply, and they do not authorize a threshold change.

reporting_correction.reason: The first grouped SQL used a window denominator over grouped reason rows and produced impossible percentages above 100%. Counts were valid; those percentages were discarded.

freshness_policy_evidence.interpretation: The frozen 10-second selected-token event-age rule appears potentially restrictive for 5m execution coverage in this post-merge snapshot, but the relevant stale-book sample is only n=2. That is insufficient evidence for a policy revision.
freshness_policy_evidence.next_evidence_action: Keep the 10-second rule frozen and continue money-disabled prospective collection. Re-run the same classification against a materially larger post-merge sample, keeping the evidence start fixed at 2026-08-31T16:29:33Z.
